summary: Newman has no species page for this greenbul, and the Wikipedia article does not describe the plumage, so no colours, size, habitat or status are stored. Avibase marks it rare or accidental in Kruger, so the months are unset. There is no Kemp estimate. The grade A calls from South Africa are ND, so the playable recording is a grade A alarm call from Kibira, Burundi.

similar.note: Yellow-bellied Greenbul is the yellow-underpart bird of riverine forest. No plumage description was available here for Yellow-streaked Greenbul.
